name: Sunstretch the Red Tabby Cat
blurb: Sunstretch, a red-orange tabby with bold black stripes and amber eyes, starts every day with one long, slow stretch on the warm garden path.

name: Paprika the Striped Cat
blurb: Paprika, a deep rust-red tabby with dark brown stripes and green eyes, trots easy laps around the flower beds, then naps in the shade.

name: Warmup the Ginger Tabby Cat
blurb: Warmup, a ginger tabby with wide dark stripes and a cream chest, crouches low and wiggles before every pounce at the swaying garden grass.
